question: 查询各分行信用卡交易金额
business_summary: 按分行汇总已入账信用卡交易金额
sql: SELECT b.branch_name AS branch, SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS credit_card_transaction_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t JOIN dim_branch b ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question: 查询近30天信用卡交易笔数
business_summary: 统计近30天已入账信用卡交易去重笔数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS credit_card_transaction_count FROM dwd_card_transaction WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT' AND transaction_status = 'POSTED' AND transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

question: 查询近30天各分行信用卡交易金额和排名
business_summary: 使用 CTE 计算分行交易额并以窗口函数排名
sql: WITH branch_totals AS (SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t JOIN dim_branch b ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' AND t.transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY b.branch_name) SELECT branch_totals.branch_name, branch_totals.amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY branch_totals.amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM branch_totals ORDER BY amount_rank

question: 按交易渠道查询交易金额
business_summary: 按交易渠道汇总已入账交易金额
sql: SELECT t.transaction_channel, SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS transaction_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t WHERE t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' GROUP BY t.transaction_channel ORDER BY transaction_amount DESC

question: 查询各分行平均交易金额
business_summary: 按分行计算已入账交易平均金额
sql: SELECT b.branch_name, AVG(t.txn_amount_cny) AS average_transaction_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t JOIN dim_branch b ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question: 查询各分行活跃客户数
business_summary: 按分行统计发生已入账交易的去重客户数
sql: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS active_customer_count FROM dwd_card_transaction t JOIN dim_branch b ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question: 查询信用卡交易金额前5名分行
business_summary: 信用卡交易金额分行 Top 5
sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS credit_card_transaction_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t JOIN dim_branch b ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' GROUP BY b.branch_name ORDER BY credit_card_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 按分行和渠道查询信用卡交易金额
business_summary: 分行与交易渠道双维度信用卡交易汇总
sql: SELECT b.branch_name, t.transaction_channel, SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS credit_card_transaction_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t JOIN dim_branch b ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' GROUP BY b.branch_name, t.transaction_channel

question: 查询POS和APP渠道信用卡交易金额
business_summary: 使用 IN 条件筛选两个虚构交易渠道
sql: SELECT t.transaction_channel, SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS credit_card_transaction_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t WHERE t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' AND t.transaction_channel IN ('POS', 'APP') GROUP BY t.transaction_channel

question: 查询高于整体均值的交易平均金额
business_summary: 使用子查询比较虚构交易金额均值
sql: SELECT AVG(t.txn_amount_cny) AS average_transaction_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t WHERE t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' AND t.txn_amount_cny > (SELECT AVG(s.txn_amount_cny) FROM dwd_card_transaction s WHERE s.transaction_status = 'POSTED')
